We have redesigned and extended the Tile Picker into a floating "page" workspace with right-click drag multi-selection, and updated enum value rows to render multi-tile regions with preserved aspect ratios. All coordinate transformations now route through a dedicated `PickerView` with fit-zoom and middle/Space panning, while pure coordinate math is isolated in `tile_bounds.rs` with full unit test coverage.

### Cause of Each Bug
1. **Top-Left Anchoring & Stiff Navigation**: Coordinates were directly tied to the raw canvas offset rather than a centered LDtk-style page workspace with margins, and right-click was hardcoded to pan instead of selection.
2. **Grid Overflowing Canvas**: Grid line rendering iterated across the full canvas bounds instead of being clipped strictly to the tileset's image panel rect (`screen_page_rect`).
3. **Single Tile Restriction & Distorted Aspect Ratios**: The selection model only stored a scalar `u32` tile ID without 2D bounding rectangle support (`TileRect`), preventing rectangular block selections and causing multi-tile regions to lack aspect-ratio-preserving UV scaling in enum rows.

### Files Changed
- [`crates/lc_shell/src/ui/tile_bounds.rs`](file:///home/azkin/dev/level-craft/crates/lc_shell/src/ui/tile_bounds.rs): Pure coordinate math and bounds logic (`TileGrid`, `TileRect`), cell normalization, clamping, UV union rects, and unit tests.
- [`crates/lc_shell/src/ui/tile_picker.rs`](file:///home/azkin/dev/level-craft/crates/lc_shell/src/ui/tile_picker.rs): Unified `PickerView` (`page_to_screen` / `screen_to_page`), LDtk page centering with margins, middle-click and Space+left-drag panning, Ctrl+scroll zoom, grid clipping, right-drag multi-selection with snapped cyan box, auto-scroll, and dimension badge (`#ID (WxH)`).
- [`crates/lc_shell/src/ui/mod.rs`](file:///home/azkin/dev/level-craft/crates/lc_shell/src/ui/mod.rs) & [`crates/lc_shell/src/lib.rs`](file:///home/azkin/dev/level-craft/crates/lc_shell/src/lib.rs): Re-exported `TileGrid`, `TileRect`, and `PickerView`.
- [`crates/lc_shell/src/shell_app.rs`](file:///home/azkin/dev/level-craft/crates/lc_shell/src/shell_app.rs): Added `enum_value_tile_rects` and `get_enum_value_tile_rect` providing backward compatibility for single-tile selections.
- [`crates/lc_shell/src/enum_view.rs`](file:///home/azkin/dev/level-craft/crates/lc_shell/src/enum_view.rs): Connected `TilePickerEvent::Selected(TileRect)` and added aspect-ratio-preserving rendering for multi-tile buttons in enum value rows.
- [`crates/lc_shell/tests/tile_picker_test.rs`](file:///home/azkin/dev/level-craft/crates/lc_shell/tests/tile_picker_test.rs): Added headless integration tests for view centering, zoom bounds, and right-click drag multi-selection lifecycle.
